test_container_launch_dispatcher: test the container launch dispatcher with parameterized interactive, mount_gcs_path, gcs_dir_exists, and gpu_count configurations
test_container_launch_by_client: test the Docker Python client container launch with parameterized mount_gcs_path, gcs_dir_exists, and gpu_count configurations
test_container_launch_by_subprocess: test the Docker subprocess container launch with parameterized mount_gcs_path, gcs_dir_exists, and gpu_count configurations
test_no_nvidia_smi_launch: test that launching with gpu_count greater than 0 raises RuntimeError when nvidia-smi is unavailable
test_launch_local_binary: test launching a local binary executable and verifying its handle, returncode, and stdout output
